description: Harvested 9 lb of turnips from the cottage garden
body: Pulled the turnips planted in June: 9 lb, one of them shaped like Mr. Pumpernickel.

description: Dr. Jekyll lowered moonberry tonic to 3 drops nightly; the ear has stopped glowing
body: The ear has stopped glowing, even in the dark. Dr. Jekyll lowered the moonberry tonic from 4 to 3 drops nightly. Starlight syrup stays at 1 teaspoon at lunch. Next visit in December.

description: Chimney goblin got past the new cap, a third visit; Thatch & Sons to return 2026-10-08 under guarantee
body: The goblin got in again, past the new cap, and took the tea cosy. Third time this year. Old Man Thatch says the cap is under its one-year guarantee and will come back on 2026-10-08 to fit a finer mesh at no charge.
